description: LISTED BUILDING CONSENT TO ADD AN ADDITIONAL ENTRANCE TO THE SCHOOL FRONT COURTYARD. TO HAVE SUPPLIED AND INSTALLED A TWIN TURNSTILE GATE WAY INCLUDING ELECTRICS AND ENTRY CONTROL SYSTEM. TO BUILD A CONCRETE BASE FOR THE TURNSTILE TO STAND ON AND SUPPLY NEW COBBLE STONE AND RESIN FINISH TO MATCH EXISTING. TO CUT TWO LENGTHS OF RAILINGS AND RE-PURPOSE TO ALIGN THE SIDE AS A BOUNDARY WALL TO THE NEW TURNSTILE. TO REMOVE THE OVAL PLANT BED AND TREE IN FRONT OF THE RAILINGS. FLOWERS TO BE RE-PLANT WITHIN THE GARDEN IN FRONT OF THE MUSIC BUILDING TO PURCHASE A NEW TREE AND LOCATE IN FRONT OF THE MUSIC BLOCK GARDEN. THE PURPOSE OF THE PROJECT IS TO ADD EXTRA SECURITY AND SAFEGUARDING TO THE STAFF AND PUPILS. IT WILL ENABLE US TO REGULATE ACCESS TO THE SITE DURING THE SCHOOL DAY.
